correctness.rationale: Explicit row-major encoding bijects 65,536 integers with M_4(F_2). The finite program checks ordinary field multiplication, all 316 square-zero N and all 5,317 tripotents T, verifies 1,680,172 ordered summands via a direct pair census, independently computes the 16-bit integer Walsh convolution and requires entry-by-entry equality. It separately lists all 34 primary rational types and sizes from the centralizer unit formula and requires the resulting weighted histogram to match. Fundamental polynomial identities and class-size formulas are reconstructed in RESULT.md. The proof is exhaustive only in dimension four.

value.rationale: At the first dimension after the cubic obstruction, the exact multiplicity of fixed-exponent decompositions is a natural rigidity measure independent of an existence theorem. The complete 25-level distribution and 34 similarity-class refinement supply natural, previously unreported precise data: uniqueness only at zero, nonzero minimum three on exactly one class of 1,120 matrices, and maximum among nonidentity matrices 162 on the rank-three idempotent class of 120 matrices. These sharp boundaries reveal substantial nonuniformity obscured by qualitative existence and support comparing constructive algorithms and presentation redundancy.
